description: Retrieves a single email message by id, including body and attachment metadata. For whole conversations use get_thread. Use PLAIN_TEXT to prevent context exhaustion.

messageFormat.description: MINIMAL: subject, snippet, sender, recipients, date, labels. METADATA_ONLY: no subject/snippet/body. PLAIN_TEXT (recommended): MINIMAL + plaintextBody + attachments (HTML converted to text if needed). FULL_CONTENT (default): also htmlBody. RAW: raw MIME.

messageId.description: Message id from search_threads or get_thread.

name: get_message
